messages:
alex: FYI: vendor Cobalt booked a staged engagement for Wed next week. They asked for KMS encrypt/decrypt on a single test key and some IAM assume-role access. Proposing a 3-hr "scan corridor" 11:00-14:00 PDT. Thoughts?

priya: 👍 need to narrow exact scope. Do we allow decrypt or only encrypt/sign? Vendor asked for both but we can scope to a single test key.

toni: Strong preference: give encrypt/decrypt on a dedicated test key with an explicit key policy that forbids policy edits, rotations, and key deletion. Ephemeral creds only.

infra: We can generate an ephemeral IAM role and expose it via STS. Example for testers: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222222:role/cobalt-pt-staging --role-session-name cobalt-session --duration-seconds 3600
```
We'll land the role in infra repo via a small terraform change. Need rbac reviewers.

alex: Good. Priya, can you draft the key policy snippet? Keep it explicit about allowed KMS actions and deny for kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion/kms:PutKeyPolicy.

priya: Will do. Also: we must snapshot telemetry during the run. Suggested list: CloudTrail events for KMS and IAM, S3 access logs for artifacts, VPC flow logs for source IPs, app request traces.

ops-bot: automated: scheduled CloudTrail export to s3://secure-audit/engagements/cobalt-1912345679 at 14:10 PDT (retention: 180 days).

toni: 180d retention? Security runbook suggests 90d for pen tests, but legal wanted 180 for regulated customers. I'll defer to compliance.

security-bot: alert: set CloudWatch metric filter for >40 kms:Decrypt calls/min from any single principal during window -> trigger Pager duty.

alex: Agree on alarm but set PD only for critical spikes. Medium/low findings should land in triage board. Oncall should only be paged for severity >= high.

infra: Deploy freeze proposed 10:30-14:30 in staging to reduce noise. I'll post in #releases and annotate the infra PR.

priya: For RBAC: no wide-open policy edits during the corridor. Quick mitigations OK via PR with expedited review: reviewers will be alex + toni. No emergency wildcard allow statements.

toni: For evidence packaging we'll standardize ticket fields: steps, proof-of-concept, affected resources (ARNS), CloudTrail event ids, request/response pairs, and screenshots if UI. Use label "cobalt-pt" and severity per CVSS.

alex: Agreed. Also require a proposed remediation and a proposed retest window for each finding. Retest SLA: vendor will re-run specific finding tests within 4 business days after fix verification. Keep retest to max 2h session per ticket.

priya: Operational detail: give vendor only the test key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222:key/staging-cobalt-key. Key policy will include a condition restricting source IPs to the vendor IP range during the window.

infra: I'll include the IP whitelist in terraform and document the assume-role CLI. Will tag the PR "urgent:pt" and request fast-track.

ops-bot: automated: bridge created -> https://infra.company/bridges/cobalt-1912345679 (created by ops-bot)

toni: Oncall paging: only for Critical/High vulnerabilities that have active exploitation or service impact. For low/medium, collect and triage after the corridor.

alex: We should also pre-create triage tickets with templates so we can attach evidence quickly. Toni, can you spin the template?

toni: Yup. I'll create a ticket template in the security board with checklist items and file attachments section.

priya: Add an S3 path convention for artifacts: s3://secure-audit/engagements/cobalt-1912345679/{finding-id}/. Keep objects immutable for retention period.

security-bot: reminder: do not rotate the test key during the engagement window. Any rotation event will invalidate evidence.

infra: Also, set a CloudTrail read-only role for reviewers to inspect events without altering key policies. That will be separate from the test role.

alex: Action items recap:
- infra: terraform patch for role + IP whitelist + read-only trail role (PR by Tue EOD)
- priya: key policy + evidence S3 path & retention proposal (Wed)
- toni: ticket template + triage board setup (Wed)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm CloudTrail export timing & immutability (Wed)
- security-bot: alarm thresholds + PD rules (Tue)

priya: I'll draft a short runbook blurb for #releases describing the corridor, freeze, and who to contact.

alex: If nobody raises blockers by EOD tomorrow, we'll lock the schedule and authorize infra PR merge after review. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: automated: scheduled reminder set for Tue 09:00 PDT to confirm infra PR status.
